reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Observable Plot (https://observablehq.com/plot/).
Technology stack: javascript, svg, typescript.
Component specification: 最后开 Bar mark：字母柱状图和 barY 代码叠在一起。
